annotations.title: Explain an EVM transaction: status, fee, decoded method, ERC-20/721 transfers

description: Explain an EVM transaction: status, fee, decoded method, ERC-20/721 transfers. Fetches a transaction and its receipt from a public RPC: from/to, value, status, block and time, gas used, effective gas price and fee in native currency, the decoded method call, and every Transfer event (ERC-20 amounts formatted with token decimals and symbols, ERC-721 token ids). Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).

chain.description: One of ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc, avalanche, gnosis, base-sepolia, sepolia (or a chain id)
